reuse.why: Adds the closed-account check to the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard that all six provider link functions already call before touching anything.

duplication.why: The check and message exist once; no provider gets its own copy.

placement.why: The pre-link guard in accounts/app.ts is the right layer, though a function named for the already-linked rule now also carries the closed rule (the comment is updated, the name is not).

scope.why: Focused guard change with tests and a release note, but the tests go in a new app.test.ts next to the existing app-bank-sync.test.ts suite instead of extending it.

maintainability.why: Simple and covers every provider in one place; the guard name no longer describes everything it checks.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount, linkFintegraAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount
